operations.title: Get Unread Emails
operations.description: Retrieves all unread emails from your Microsoft Outlook account. You can also mark the retrieved Unread emails as 'Read'.

parameters.title: User ID/User Principal Name
parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: The User ID or User Principal Name (usually an email address) using which you want to retrieve unread emails from your Microsoft Outlook account.
parameters.tooltip: The User ID or User Principal Name (usually an email address) using which you want to retrieve unread emails from your Microsoft Outlook account.

parameters.title: Source Folder
parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Select the source of the folder from which you want to retrieve unread emails from your Microsoft Outlook account. To specify a source, you can choose between 'Folder ID' or 'Folder Path'.
parameters.tooltip: Select the source of the folder from which you want to retrieve unread emails from your Microsoft Outlook account. To specify a source, you can choose between 'Folder ID' or 'Folder Path'.

Folder ID.title: Folder ID
Folder ID.name: folder_id
Folder ID.tooltip: If you want to retrieve emails from a nested folder, then you need to specify folder IDs in the Parent_folder_id/child_folder_id format.
Folder ID.description: If you choose 'Folder ID', then in the Folder ID field, specify the ID of the folder from which you want to retrieve emails. If you want to retrieve emails from a nested folder, then you need to specify folder IDs in the Parent_folder_id/child_folder_id format.

Folder Path.title: Folder Path
Folder Path.name: folder_id
Folder Path.tooltip: If you want to retrieve emails from the parent level folder, then you only need to specify the name of the parent folder, for example, Inbox. If you want to retrieve emails from a child folder then specify folder path. Eg. Inbox/Phishing.
Folder Path.description: If you choose 'Folder Path', then in the Folder Path field, specify the mailbox from which you want to retrieve emails. If you want to retrieve emails from the parent level folder, then you only need to specify the name of the parent folder, for example, Inbox. If you want to retrieve emails from a child folder, then you need to specify the folder path. For example to retrieve emails from the 'Phishing' mailbox that is present within the 'Inbox folder', enter Inbox/Phishing in this field.

parameters.title: Mark as Read
parameters.name: mark_as_read
parameters.tooltip: To mark all the retrieved unread emails from your Microsoft Outlook account as Read.
parameters.description: Select this option, i.e., set it to True (default), to mark all the retrieved unread emails from your Microsoft Outlook account as Read. By default, this is set to True.

parameters.title: Parse Inline Images
parameters.name: parse_inline
parameters.tooltip: To retrieve the body of the emails including inline images.
parameters.description: Select this option, i.e., set it to True, to retrieve the body of the emails including inline images from your Microsoft Outlook account. By default, this is set to False (option is unchecked).

parameters.title: Save Email
parameters.name: save_email
parameters.tooltip: To save the retrieved email as a file in the 'Attachments' module.
parameters.description: Select this option, i.e., set it to True, to save the retrieved email as a file in the 'Attachments' module. By default, this is set to False (option is unchecked).

parameters.title: Limit
parameters.name: limit
parameters.tooltip: The maximum number of emails to return in response. Default 20
parameters.description: (Optional) The maximum number of emails, based on your filter criterion, you want to include in the output of this operation. If you do not specify anything in this field then all unread emails based on your filter criterion will be included in the output of this operation. By default, this is set to 20.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.tooltip: The User ID or User Principal Name (usually an email address) whose mailbox you want to search for emails.

parameters.name: source

Folder ID.title: Folder ID
Folder ID.name: folder_id
Folder ID.tooltip: If you want to retrieves mails from a nested folder in this case you need to provide folder IDs below format E.g. Parent_folder_id/child_folder_id.
Folder ID.description: Provide folder ID from which you want to retrieves emails. If you want to retrieves mails from a nested folder in this case you need to provide folder IDs below format E.g. Parent_folder_id/child_folder_id.

Folder Path.title: Folder Path
Folder Path.name: folder_id
Folder Path.tooltip: If you want to search for emails from the parent level folder, then you only need to specify the name of the parent folder, for example, Inbox. If you want to search for emails from a child folder, then you need to specify the folder path. For example Inbox/Phishing.

If you want to search for emails from the parent level folder, then you only need to specify the name of the parent folder, for example, Inbox. If you want to search for emails from a child folder, then you need to specify the folder path. parameters.title: Odata Query
parameters.name: odata_query
parameters.tooltip: Note: The query parameter '$filter' is not supported when using the 'Search' parameter.

parameters.description: Select this option, i.e., set it to True, to search and retrieve the body of the emails including inline images from your Microsoft Outlook account. By default, this is set to False (option is unchecked).

parameters.title: Limit

parameters.tooltip: The maximum number of emails to return in response. Default 20
parameters.description: (Optional) The maximum number of emails, based on your filter criterion, you want to include in the result of this operation. By default, this is set to 20.

parameters.tooltip: The email address from which you want to sent the email.
parameters.description: The email address from which you want to sent the email.

parameters.title: Body Type
parameters.name: body_type
parameters.description: Select the format in which you want to send the email. You can choose from the following options: Rich Text: Select to specify a subject and body of the email. Email Template: Select an email template to use to send the email. An existing email template is passed as an input for the email subject and body (content) allowing you to leverage an existing email template and build upon it, thereby, avoiding re-work and ensuring consistency.
